name: Data grid
purpose: The interactive data table: sort, filter, row selection and edit-in-place for data-dense fintech screens (transactions, payees, batch approvals). The distinct component the gated Table's rubric decision A anticipated (2026-06-22: 'if a sortable table is ever needed it should be a distinct component') — Table stays the PASSIVE semantic table; the grid owns interaction on the ARIA grid pattern. Peer shapes: Carbon DataTable, Ant Table, AG-Grid.
$composes: Selection-controls (s258-D4, TIGHTENED at #261 G3 on Dave's word — "the grid header is fine except the checkbox is rendered oddly, can't we just use the check component?". The header select-all and every row checkbox ARE the .cn-selection-controls scope; the grid no longer RESTATES the anatomy on its own vars. Selection-controls is not registered as a $partial in component-types.json, so the composition route of the #261 lane brief applies: its checkbox rule block is carried into the snippet BYTE-IDENTICALLY (only a `.cbx ` scope prefix added) and bound through an alias layer that maps its var names onto the grid's already-resolved tokens of the same semantic value — --ctrl-border=form/border/default, --ctrl-border-active, --glyph=text/on-inverse, --checked=secondary/background/default, --chip-hover=form/background/hover, --ctrl-border-disabled. Its OWN two glyphs are consumed: the animated stroke-draw tick for checked and its own dash for indeterminate, both declared data-bespoke and already verified in _ICON-SOURCE-AUDIT.md. Two grid-authored lines remain and both are marked in the snippet: the 44px label that carries the hit area (32px in compact, above the 24px floor), and a stroke-dasharray on .mixed without which the component's stroke-dashoffset is inert. The class names are KEPT so a diff proves the borrow; the grid supplies only the ids, aria-label and the indeterminate state.) Search-field (the filter field's boxed chrome, FIELD-CHROME-COPY). Tags (the applied-filter chips, namespaced .fchip). Pagination (44px pager targets, aria-current border). Skeleton-loader (the loading state, by reference). Account-selector (aria-selected = tint + inset start bar). Button (sort headers, .full because they are cell-bound).

props.name: columns
props.$note: Column defs: key · label · numeric (right-aligned, .t-cm-figure-5 tabular) · sortable · editable. Sort headers are full-cell buttons riding .t-cm-button (16/500 — Table's header weight via composite).

props.name: selection
props.$note: Leading checkbox column (Selection-controls anatomy); header checkbox = page scope, indeterminate when partial.

props.name: filters
props.$note: Search-committed terms rendered as dismissible chips (Tags recipe, namespaced .fchip); terms AND-combine across text columns.

props.name: pageSize
props.$note: Footer: range read-out · rows-per-page select · pagination (Pagination recipe: 44px targets, aria-current border).

props.name: state
props.$note: loading = aria-busy + Skeleton bones (by reference); empty = message + clear-filters recovery action.
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C1 -- no-bind:state-selector. A state enum selects among per-state token SETS (colour-semantic); per-state maps are the colour-spine lane's job (not yet migrated). Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: density
props.$note: #261: a real prop on .dg (data-density), not a demo dial. Compact drops --cell-py 10->4, the header row 44->32 and every control target 44->32 — above the 24px dial-down floor, never below (s116-D1). The switch mirrors Segmented-control (its group, not button-family: no press physics).

props.name: groupHeader
props.$note: #261: an OPTIONAL spanning row above the column row (th scope=colgroup), sticky at top:0 with the column row sticking below it at top:var(--grp-h). It counts as a header row: aria-rowcount and every aria-rowindex shift by one when it is on.

props.name: columnFilters
props.$note: #261: per-column filter menu behind a 24px header button. Committing writes a {key, term} filter, which renders as a chip that names its column ('Payee: acme'); the toolbar filter is the same shape with key null. Amount ships WITHOUT one — the affordance is optional per column, and a contains-filter on money is the wrong control.

variants.name: default
variants.use: group row on, comfortable density, a filter on every text column — the transactions board header

variants.name: compact
variants.use: data-density=compact: 32px header row, 32px targets, 4px cell padding; for a dense back-office console where the operator wants rows, not air

variants.name: no-group-row
variants.use: data-groups=off: the column row alone, sticky at top:0; aria-rowcount and every rowindex drop by one

variants.name: header-filters-off
variants.use: omit the .colf button per column (Amount ships this way): sort and resize stay, the toolbar filter still covers the text columns

stateModel.$scope: the COLUMN HEADER (#261); the grid's live/loading/empty modes stay on the `state` prop
stateModel.sorted: aria-sort ascending|descending + the direction glyph + a ground shift to tertiary/background/hover + a 2px form/border/active UNDERLINE. Four channels; colour is never alone. #261 G2: the rule was 3px and Dave read it as a heavy black line — it is now 2px, and it is the ONLY edge the sorted state paints.
stateModel.filtered-active: data-filtered=true + the SOLID library glyph (filter-active.svg, a different glyph, not a recolour) + a held form/background/hover ground on the filter button + a chip in the bar that names the column. #261 G2: the 3px LEADING rule is REMOVED — sitting on a cell's start edge it read as the RIGHT-hand black line of the column before it (Dave, on the review specimen where Date was sorted and Payee filtered). Sorted and filtered still coexist on one column: they no longer share an edge because filtered no longer HAS one.
stateModel.menu-open: aria-expanded=true on the filter button, the menu shown under its own cell, the field focused and pre-filled with the term in force; Esc closes and returns focus to the header cell.
stateModel.resizing: data-resizing on the grid (col-resize cursor, hover suppressed) + data-active on the separator (full-height 2px form/border/default grip); aria-valuenow tracks the live width and the commit is announced. #261 G2: at REST the separator paints nothing — a 1px hairline appears on hover or focus-visible of the handle only.
stateModel.disabled: aria-disabled + a disabled button + an alpha mute and NO sort glyph. text/disabled is #E1E1E1 and illegible on the header ground, so the mute is alpha, not that token.
stateModel.truncated: the label ellipsises and takes a title ONLY when scrollWidth actually exceeds clientWidth — re-measured after every resize and density change, so no phantom tooltips.

sort-header.use: Full-cell button in columnheader; aria-sort cycles none→ascending→descending; glyphs sort/chevron-up/chevron-down (library). Carries .full — cell-bound, hover grow would overflow (Button's own guard).
sort-header.$261: The button now sits inside .th-in beside the column filter and the resize handle; the label truncates (.lbl, text-box-edge:text text) and takes a title ONLY when measured to truncate; sorted paints a ground shift plus a 2px form/border/active UNDERLINE (3px until #261 G2), and the disabled column (Reference) carries aria-disabled with no sort glyph at all.

selection-checkbox.use: COMPOSED from Selection-controls (s258-D4), not re-drawn: the wrapper carries the canon scope class .cn-selection-controls and Selection-controls' own pattern — visually-hidden <input> + sibling <label> holding <span class="box"> with the tick/mixed bespoke control glyphs — so a verbatim copy into a canon.css page inherits the reviewed control and passes the composition gate. 22×22 box inside a 44px label target; checked = secondary/background/default + text/on-inverse; the select-all also carries :indeterminate (the mixed dash). Colour states only — no scale physics (form-control precedent).

filter-field.use: Search-field boxed chrome (FIELD-CHROME-COPY — receipted field-family accretion evidence). Enter commits the term as a chip.

applied-chip.use: Dismissible Tags recipe, namespaced .fchip (.tag/.chip are type.css-bound blast radii). Dismiss × = 24px button-family member; Tags' tactile × motion deliberately NOT copied (motion belongs to the partial, B-D7).

edit-cell.use: Reference column; Enter/F2/double-click opens; editing chrome = field ACTIVE recipe (border/active 4px bottom stroke + page fill); Esc cancels, Enter/blur commits; announced.

pagination.use: Prev/next chevrons + page numbers; current = tertiary/border/default + .t-cm-button (500 via composite, not raw weight); inverting colour press (tertiary/background/pressed + text/reverse).

column-filter.use: #261. A 24px form-furniture button in the header cell (Search-field precedent — colour states, no press physics) opening a small menu anchored under its own cell: one labelled text input, Enter commits, Esc closes, an outside click closes. Off/on are two DISTINCT library glyphs (global-controls/filter.svg, filter-active.svg), never one glyph recoloured (icon-011). #261 G2: filtered-active paints NO edge rule — its channels are the distinct glyph, a held ground on the button and the named chip; the 3px leading accent was removed on Dave's review.

column-resizer.use: #261. A 12px grip on the trailing edge of the header cell with a 24px hit area (the ::before bleed) and — since #261 G2, on Dave's 'remove the bars from the end of the column headers' — NO painted rule at rest: a 1px hairline shows on hover/focus-visible of the handle, the full-height grip only while resize mode is live. The affordance is unchanged (cursor, hit area, drag, keyboard). role=separator + aria-orientation/valuenow/valuemin/valuemax, driving the <col> width in a table-layout:fixed table (96-480px clamp). Pointer drag, and keyboard from the header cell: Alt+Left/Right enters resize mode, arrows size (Shift for a 32px step), Esc/Enter returns to the cell — so the grid keeps its ONE tab stop.

group-header.use: #261. Optional spanning row of th scope=colgroup above the column row; caption type at 60% alpha on table/column/background. Both rows are sticky and travel as one block. Sticky plus border-collapse drops cell borders while scrolling, so the header's rules are painted as inset shadows.

tokens.row-chrome: table/header/background · table/column/background · table/border — consumed from Table unchanged; cells background/default; row hover tertiary/background/hover
tokens.selected-row: form/background/hover tint + 4px inset start bar form/border/active + checked box (never colour alone); distinct semantic source from hover so themes can split them
tokens.field-chrome: form/border/default · form/border/active · form/background/hover (Search-field/Input-fields recipe — accretion evidence)
tokens.type: composites only via markup class — headers .t-cm-button · data .t-cm-label · amounts .t-cm-figure-5 (tabular) · captions .t-cm-caption · editor/search .t-cm-input
tokens.radius: border-radius/control · surface · indicator role tokens (Mono resolves 0; themes flex, ADR-0010)
tokens.$survey: Mined, never modified: Table (visual canon — row chrome, density, weights), Search-field (field chrome, BY COPY — receipted accretion evidence), Tags (chip recipe), Selection-controls (checkbox anatomy), Pagination (footer recipe), Skeleton-loader (bones, by reference), Account-selector (aria-selected idiom), Icon-button/Button (physics geometry + marker protocol).
tokens.header: #261 — thead ground table/header/background; group row table/column/background; the sorted 2px underline is form/border/active (--bar); filtered carries no rule (#261 G2); the resize hairline is form/border/default, painted on hover/focus only; disabled column is an alpha mute, NOT text/disabled (#E1E1E1 is illegible on the header ground); every header rule is an inset shadow so sticky keeps it.

motion.press: Sort headers, chip dismiss ×, clear-filters, pagination = button-family members; empty AUTO-PARTIAL markers await injection on registration (ADR-0013; $members proposal in the worker receipt). No local press-shaped CSS anywhere.
motion.reducedMotion: Global collapse + static bones; the injected partial carries its own override.

responsive.rule: Horizontal scroll region + sticky header — a DELIBERATE divergence from Table's card-collapse: collapsing to cards orphans the columnheader/aria-sort relationships the grid's AT contract depends on (peer-grid shape). Reflow duty is met by the passive Table; min-width 640px, container width demo-controlled to 320px. #261: the region also takes a vertical max-block-size (--dg-vh, 380px default) so the sticky header is a provable state; default column widths sum to the 760px min-width, so nothing is cut before the user resizes.

selection-controls.route: byte-identical rule block + alias layer (no $partial registered for the checkbox)
selection-controls.consumer: knowledge/snippets/Data-grid.reference.html — `.cbx` scope, header select-all + every row cell
gridAuthored: .mixed stroke-dasharray:22 (guard: the component's offset is inert without it)

behaviour.fallback: The table body is EMPTY — `<tbody id="tbody">` carries only a comment and every row is rendered by the script, so with JS off there is no data at all: no rows, no chips, no pager buttons that do anything. The COLUMN HEADER still paints in full — group row, labels, sort glyphs at aria-sort=none, the filter buttons, the resize handles and the density switch — but none of them act: sorting, column filtering, column resizing, the density toggle, truncation measurement, chip dismissal, paging, select-all, edit-in-place and the APG roving cell focus are all gone. The search field, the rows-per-page select and the authored footer range text still paint.

$note.sort: Header sort buttons cycle none -> ascending -> descending; the cycle re-renders the body and the pager.
$note.filter: The search field filters on keydown and the chip bar mirrors the active filters; each chip's `x` drops one filter, the clear control drops them all.
$note.edit: Double-click on a `td.edit` opens an inline input; keydown commits or cancels and blur commits.
$note.keyboard: APG grid roving cell focus on the table: one tab stop, arrows move the current cell, and focus is restored across re-renders by cell id.
$note.$unproven: Prose derived from the snippet's own script and comments at #258 L3, not from a driven probe.
$note.header: #261 — sort cycles on the header button and on Enter/Space from the cell; the column filter menu opens from the 24px button or Alt+Down and commits on Enter; the resize handle drags on pointer events and sizes on arrows after Alt+Left/Right; the density switch rewrites data-density; labels are re-measured for truncation after every render, resize and density change.

accessibility.semantics: Native <table> + role=grid; aria-rowcount/aria-rowindex track the FILTERED set across pages and COUNT the optional group row; columnheaders carry aria-sort (only the sortable ones — the disabled column carries aria-disabled and no aria-sort at all); the group row is th scope=colgroup; rows carry aria-selected.
accessibility.keyboard: APG grid: ONE tab stop, roving tabindex over cells — arrows move, Home/End row ends, Ctrl+Home/End grid ends; Enter/Space activates the cell's widget (sort · checkbox · edit); F2/double-click edits; Esc cancels. Widgets inside cells are tabindex=-1 so Tab exits the grid. #261 adds two header-cell affordances, both on Alt so plain arrows still navigate: Alt+Down opens that column's filter menu, Alt+Left/Right enters resize mode on the separator (arrows size, Shift for a bigger step, Esc/Enter returns).
accessibility.announcements: Visually-hidden role=status (polite) narrates sort, selection counts, filter apply/remove, page, edit commit/cancel; the visible results count is aria-live too.
accessibility.states: Selected = tint + inset bar + checked box (1.4.1); loading = aria-busy + role=status text, bones aria-hidden (decorative); empty offers a real recovery action; focus ring 2px focus/ring, offset -2 (axs-004). #261 header states: hover · focus-visible (the cell's own 2px focus/ring token at offset -2, never a black box) · sorted (ground + a 2px accent underline + glyph + aria-sort) · filtered-active (the solid filter glyph + a held button ground + a chip naming the column; NO edge rule) · resizing (accent grip + col-resize cursor) · disabled column (alpha mute, no sort affordance) · truncated label (ellipsis + a title only when measured to truncate).
accessibility.editing: Editor is a labelled text input ('Edit reference for <payee>'); commit/cancel announced; grid navigation suspended while editing (keys stay in the editor).

antiPatterns: Bolting sort/selection onto the passive Table (decision A: they are distinct components)
Card-collapse on an interactive grid (orphans columnheader/aria-sort AT relationships)
Sort direction by colour or icon-opacity alone (aria-sort + distinct glyphs here; icons stay full-ink, icon-011)
Selection shown by tint alone (bar + checkbox carry it structurally)
Local press physics on grid controls (button-family partial territory — the ratchet bites)
A second tab stop inside the grid (widgets are reached from cells, not Tab)
Sorting a column whose cells are editable (re-ordering rows under an open editor) — the Reference column's sort is disabled by design, and that is the shipped disabled-column example

A header state that paints a RIGHT-EDGE bar — #261 G2 removed the last one (filtered's leading accent, which read as the previous column's right edge); the only trailing rule is the 1px table/border column hairline
A resize handle as a second tab stop — it is a tabindex=-1 separator reached from the header cell with Alt+arrow
